review: Every helper is limited to its explicit owner root or the ten named new skill directories.
Global copies require absent destinations; source and installed bytes are checked.
Subprocess calls select declared Python, Git, creator, and document tools with argument arrays rather than shell-built user data.
The canonical marker and receipt are exclusive writes outside the sealed worktree.
Runner APIs have no network or process-launch imports and have strict finite-input budgets.
No claim of independent review or exhaustive security is made.
